description: Absolute quiet facing a courtyard : the perfect peaceful haven for 6 guests in the heart of Paris. This toasty, well-heated apartment features 2 private bedrooms for your comfort.📍 Prime Location:- 🚇 2 min: Metro Arts et Métiers & local shops.- 🏰 10 min: Le Marais & its trendy boutiques on foot.- 🏛️ 15 min: Louvre Museum (25 min Eiffel Tower).Enjoy your coffee on a terrace and discover the best bakeries right at your doorstep. Experience the authentic Parisian lifestyle you'll love!The space✨ Parisian elegance: Your efuge in the heart of the Marais ✨📍 The dream location (Historic Marais)Welcome to our magnificent apartment, nestled on the first floor of a quiet courtyard right in the heart of the famous Marais district. This exceptional location puts you steps away from art galleries, trendy boutiques, and the best cafes in Paris. Metro and bus access are within walking distance, offering you a quick connection to the whole city.🛋️ Living spaces and sleeping arrangementsIdeal for families, groups, or professionals, the apartment combines charm and functionality, offering a large capacity:- Bedroom 1: A comfortable double bed.- Bedroom 2: Two separate single beds.- Bright living room: A double sofa bed increasing capacity, a flat-screen TV, and large windows.- For babies: A travel cot (pack-and-play) is available upon advance request.- Climate comfort: A portable air conditioner is provided in the living room.🍽️ Professional kitchen and laundryThe modern kitchen is fully equipped to meet all your culinary needs:- Electric hob, oven, microwave, large fridge/freezer.- Dishwasher and washing machine.- Full range of utensils and appliances (coffee maker, kettle, etc.).🚿 BathroomThe bathroom features a modern shower, sink, and toilet. – hotel-type listing
